method.strategy: current V6 USDC profiles and current portfolio/batch engines
method.proxy_data: real public Binance Spot 1h candles for the same ten base assets
method.execution_rules: current corresponding USDC Spot symbol rules

finding.interpretation: The current USDC V6 strategy and engines reproduce the documented 733.306 / 7152.294 three-year results when given the same base-asset market path. The approximately 203 / 4007 real-USDC fresh run is therefore not evidence of a quote-conversion strategy defect; it starts later because the complete ten-market USDC history is unavailable before 2024-03-24 and resets the shared account to 250 immediately before an early loss regime and persistent portfolio drawdown halt.

limitations: The pre-listing proxy is not historical USDC liquidity or execution evidence.
Real USDT candles are relabelled only inside this research continuity test so the current USDC strategy can be evaluated over the same base-market history.
Current USDC exchange rules are applied to the full proxy period and are not historical point-in-time rule snapshots.
Operational Paper evaluation remains real-USDC only and must never substitute proxy candles.
